verses.text: 'How beautiful are your feet in sandals, O prince's daughter! The curves of your hips are like jewels, The work of the hands of an artist.
verses.textZh: 王女啊，你的腳在鞋中何其美好！你的大腿圓潤，好像美玉，是巧匠的手做成的。

verses.text: 'Your navel is [like] a round goblet Which never lacks mixed wine; Your belly is like a heap of wheat Fenced about with lilies.
verses.textZh: 你的肚臍如圓杯，不缺調和的酒；你的腰如一堆麥子，周圍有百合花。

verses.text: 'Your two breasts are like two fawns, Twins of a gazelle.
verses.textZh: 你的兩乳好像一對小鹿，就是母鹿雙生的。

verses.text: 'Your neck is like a tower of ivory, Your eyes [like] the pools in Heshbon By the gate of Bath-rabbim; Your nose is like the tower of Lebanon, Which faces toward Damascus.
verses.textZh: 你的頸項如象牙臺；你的眼目像希實本、巴特拉併門旁的水池；你的鼻子彷彿朝大馬色的利巴嫩塔。

verses.text: 'Your head crowns you like Carmel, And the flowing locks of your head are like purple threads; [The] king is captivated by [your] tresses.
verses.textZh: 你的頭在你身上好像迦密山；你頭上的髮是紫黑色；王的心因這下垂的髮綹繫住了。

verses.text: 'How beautiful and how delightful you are, [My] love, with [all] your charms!
verses.textZh: 我所愛的，你何其美好！何其可悅，使人歡暢喜樂！

verses.text: 'Your stature is like a palm tree, And your breasts are [like its] clusters.
verses.textZh: 你的身量好像棕樹；你的兩乳如同其上的果子，纍纍下垂。

verses.text: 'I said, 'I will climb the palm tree, I will take hold of its fruit stalks.' Oh, may your breasts be like clusters of the vine, And the fragrance of your breath like apples,
verses.textZh: 我說：我要上這棕樹，抓住枝子。願你的兩乳好像葡萄纍纍下垂，你鼻子的氣味香如蘋果；

verses.text: And your mouth like the best wine!' 'It goes [down] smoothly for my beloved, Flowing gently [through] the lips of those who fall asleep.
verses.textZh: 你的口如上好的酒。（新娘）女子說：為我的良人下咽舒暢，流入睡覺人的嘴中。

verses.text: 'I am my beloved's, And his desire is for me.
verses.textZh: 我屬我的良人，他也戀慕我。

verses.text: 'Come, my beloved, let us go out into the country, Let us spend the night in the villages.
verses.textZh: 我的良人，來吧！你我可以往田間去；你我可以在村莊住宿。

verses.text: 'Let us rise early [and go] to the vineyards; Let us see whether the vine has budded [And its] blossoms have opened, [And whether] the pomegranates have bloomed. There I will give you my love.
verses.textZh: 我們早晨起來往葡萄園去，看看葡萄發芽開花沒有，石榴放蕊沒有；我在那裡要將我的愛情給你。

verses.text: 'The mandrakes have given forth fragrance; And over our doors are all choice [fruits], Both new and old, Which I have saved up for you, my beloved.
verses.textZh: 風茄放香，在我們的門內有各樣新陳佳美的果子；我的良人，這都是我為你存留的。
